input.sql:
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5
